title: Leonardo da Vinci's Life In Reverse, From the Louvre Back to Vinci #Shorts
description:
Leonardo da Vinci's life is told backwards in this episode, beginning with his death at the manor of Cloux near Amboise in 1519 and rewinding to his birth near the Tuscan town of Vinci in 1452. The journey steps through the Roman years, the Last Supper in Milan, the abandoned clay horse, the engineer's map of Imola and the Florence workshop where he ground pigment as a boy. Every scene moves to an earlier date, so the paintings, machines and notebooks arrive in reverse order and the pattern of a working life becomes visible. Dates, places and commissions follow the documented record, and the later legends are named as legends.

Made with AI assistance.

scenes.narration: He died in France in 1519, leaving almost every project unfinished and one painting that the whole world now queues to see.
Step backwards and Leonardo da Vinci leaves Italy for a French manor, then studies hearts, rivers and birds in notebooks he never published.
Further back the bronze horse he spent years planning is destroyed by archers, and the Last Supper begins to flake while he still lives.
Before that he is a boy of fourteen at a workbench in Florence, grinding pigment in his master's shop after leaving a hill town school.
At the start there is a child born in 1452 near Vinci, left handed, illegitimate, taught without Latin and certain that he could teach himself.
